description: WRITE (gated): queue a post for FUTURE publishing, at least 15 minutes out (immediate posting is not available over MCP). Either pass post_id to promote an existing draft, or brand_id + platform to create a new scheduled post. The publishing cron sends it at the scheduled time.

post_id.description: Draft post id to promote (from content_queue)

reply_text.description: Follow-up reply posted under the main post. On X this is where a link belongs: a URL in the post body costs up to 94% of the reach (near-total on a non-Premium account), while the same URL one reply down costs nothing. Omit to reply with the brand's CTA url; pass an empty string for no reply at all. Ignored by every platform except X.

scheduled_date.description: ISO 8601, at least 15 minutes in the future

skip_hashtags.description: true = publish the caption as-is with NO brand hashtags appended; false = always append them. Omit to auto-detect: long hand-authored captions (>280 chars, no '#') skip hashtags. When promoting a draft without a new caption, omitting this keeps the draft's existing setting.

name: schedule_post
